description: This file provides utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI to ensure consistent string rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by handling delimiters like spaces, underscores, and hyphens, collapsing multiple whitespace, and ensuring proper casing.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters, collapsing spaces, and capitalizing first letters with attention to apostrophes and accented characters.
